Pure Hive Honey

Step into the story

The idea

Good things.
Ordinary moments.

A clear jar. An expressive mark. A table with room for one more. Pure Hive’s warm identity becomes a colourful world of packaging, print and everyday rituals.

The original honeycomb-and-flow mark, distinctive wordmark and four-colour palette are the starting point. This expanded study puts that identity into contemporary homes and into people’s hands.

Design
Eyilade Oridamisi
Scope
Identity, packaging concepts, art direction & campaigns
Context
Portfolio concept development. New people, food scenes and mockups are AI-assisted visualisations with fictional models.

A familiar face.
A shared spoonful.
A good beginning.

The original identity

Warm by nature.
Bold by design.

Lemon, amber, orange and ember. The supplied colours move from the lightness of a label to the confidence of a whole campaign.

The shape of a golden moment

A little structure.
A little flow.

The geometric outline makes the mark recognisable. The flowing honey brings it to life. A simple reveal lets you explore the original form.

From mark to something tangible

A shelf presence.
A personal touch.

Cream gives the signature room to breathe. A flowing orange edge carries it across the jar, gift sleeve and note. The glass lets the honey stay part of the design.

The same warmth.

Where the story began

The original
work.

The original jar application established the honey’s colour, the signature and its place on the pack. The new study carries that foundation into a broader visual world.

Historical packaging artwork is shown as an original design sample. New concepts do not make product, certification or health claims.
